messages:
elaine: Kicking off canary for release v2.14.0 in the 02:00-04:00 change window. Plan: routing 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30m. Enabling feature flag `new-ranking` for canary cohort A. Deploy bot will post smoke & CI status. pls watch telemetry :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy job started for v2.14.0 (sha: ab12cd3). Canary traffic=1% -> new-ranking=on for cohort A. CI: passed, smoke started. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.14.0

samir: noticed 5xx bump around +6m. quick log snippet: ```2026-03-21T02:06:35Z routing-service rate_limiter: quota_exceeded count=132 window=60s```

devops-jen: looks like token-bucket bursts. suggest holding ramp at 1% and increase per-node rate limit by +20% for canary nodes before continuing. Otherwise we risk cascading retries.

matthew: agree hold. also propose an automatic failover rule: if errors >0.5% for 2m, route cohort to v2.13.5 and set new-ranking=0%.

elaine: holding ramp. updating plan in PRD: 1% -> rate-limit bump -> 2% -> if errors <0.3% for 5m then 5% -> continue to 20%. I'll pin rollback target to v2.13.5 for immediate failover.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp paused at 1%. Actions logged: set runtime holdpoint, flag `canary_hold=true`, created rollback runbook https://internal.ops/runbooks/v2.14.0-rollout | notify: oncall

oncall-bot: ALERT: canary error_budget breached (threshold 0.5%). current error_rate=0.9%. paging: samir, devops-jen

samir: plan: 1) apply safe rate-limit bump (+20%) to canary nodes via infra API 2) monitor 5m avg 3) if error_rate >0.5% after 5m -> flip `new-ranking` to 0% and route affected cohorts to v2.13.5, then run smoke tests

devops-jen: rate-limit bump applied to canary nodes. command used: ```infractl update rate-limit --node-filter canary --qps-multiplier 1.2``` watching logs for 2m now. curl check for flag toggle endpoint: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -X POST https://infra.redwood/api/flags/new-ranking -d '{"percentage":0}'```

matthew: if we do flip flag off, capture evals for regression comparison. set a quick prompt set and baseline metrics to validate quality isn't degraded post-rollback.

samir: running quick evals against canary prompt set. target time for initial signal <10m. will post scores here.

elaine: posting status to release notes: "Canary paused for rate-limiter investigation. Ramp on hold." keeping thread open for updates. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Update: after rate-limit bump, 5m avg error_rate dropped to 0.28%. Canary ramp allowed to 5% per updated plan. Continuing telemetry watch and will report at next checkpoint.
